notes.title: Announcement of a new game: Trailer Park Tycoon: Raccoon Ranch
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189790/Trailer_Park_Tycoon_Raccoon_Ranch/
[b]Add to wishlists![/b]

[h2]Farm/production simulator[/h2]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3189790/extras/ezgif-6-eb41afe4ee.gif?t=1725393152[/img]
One of the key elements of the game is your production. However, instead of the usual vegetables, pies, and trinkets, you're engaged in growing tobacco, brewing alcohol, and producing goods available only to adults. In addition, you can produce coffee, soda, and energy drinks. All of this can be sold in your store!
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3189790/extras/3.png?t=1725393152[/img]

[h2]Store simulator[/h2]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3189790/extras/ezgif-6-ea968f3b21.gif?t=1725393152[/img]
The products you produce are sold in your own store. Arrange the shelves and vending machines as you like, paint the walls and floor. Visitors have their preferences and will be happy to buy products that suit them. And if you don't want to work yourself, you can hire employees to stock items and serve customers at the checkout while you interact with the trailer park residents.
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3189790/extras/2.png?t=1725393152[/img]

[h2]Fun stories[/h2]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3189790/extras/ezgif-6-6be165e6cd.gif?t=1725393152[/img]
This is the story of a resourceful raccoon who is forced to live in a trailer park full of various animals - a shy hyena, mischievous rat hooligans, a strange penguin, and many others. Each of them has their own character, problems, and desires. Get to know them all and learn their stories.
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3189790/extras/1.png?t=1725393152[/img]
